title: Explaining the Decision
objective: Resolve the status conflict with a combined text and a reason in the commit body, then print the first-parent history and the reason.
hint: Repeat the two edits and the merges from the last step. Then Set-Content with the status Status: approved, pending Alice's review, git add, and git commit -q with a subject and a second -m for the reason. Then Write-Output (git log --first-parent --format=%s), and Why: with $((git log -1 --format=%b).Trim()).
